decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and coating expertise, and its own R&D and university cooperation let it interpret early results and refine the system, so dropping it is unlikely.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the established pump and injection offering and has its own web page, so the firm's related knowledge makes it easy to assimilate feedback and improve it.
The material transfer pump line with several models builds directly on the firm's material conveying know-how and in-house manufacturing, which favours continued learning and keeping it.

Fire protection flow monitoring builds on the firm's offer, is featured on its own page, and fits the digitalised, interoperable production strategy that its R&D capacity can support, though monitoring electronics lie somewhat further from the mechanical core.
